description: This file defines a Java interface 'WithManifest' in the package 'org.eclipse.ditto.model.base.headers'. It specifies a contract for classes that have a manifest string, providing a method to retrieve it.

classes.name: WithManifest
classes.description: A functional interface for classes that have an associated manifest string, providing a method to get the manifest.

methods.name: getManifest
methods.description: Returns the manifest (type hint) as a non-null String.
